about_the_game:
"Blazing War" is a wasteland survival and monster - killing game, where you will be trapped in the ruins of the apocalypse and struggle to survive in a barren world ravaged by radiation.​

Mutated monsters are everywhere here: from slow but powerful zombies, to agile raiding creatures, and to elite monsters with special skills. Every encounter is a life - and - death battle. You can carry a gun for long - range sniping, or wield a long knife for close - range combat, and break through the encirclement with proper weapon combinations.​

The game features a variety of levels, with hidden mechanisms and traps in scenes like abandoned factories and underground passages. To pass the levels, you need to combine combat with puzzle - solving. Meanwhile, you must collect resources such as ammunition and medical supplies, upgrade your equipment and character attributes, and unlock skills like healing and berserk. Only with strength can you continue to write survival legends in desperate situations.​

Adopting the classic level - based challenge mode: Each level has independent scenes and objectives, ranging from abandoned factories to underground passages. As the levels progress, the scenes switch constantly, and the difficulty of traps and the strength of enemies gradually increase, bringing progressive challenges. If you fail to defeat all the opposing team members within the limited time, the side with more remaining members will win.​

Flexible 3D character control: You have full control over the 3D character, smoothly performing basic actions such as walking, jumping, and shooting. You can also actively launch targeted attacks and release exclusive ultimate skills. The operation feedback is precise, and the combat satisfaction is full.​

Level venue resource mechanism: Each level venue contains abundant resources. You can not only search for supplies to replenish your health but also find exclusive treasures. These treasures help to quickly improve your character's abilities and lay a foundation for advantages in subsequent battles.​

Time - limited level rules: All levels have a time limit. If you fail to defeat the level boss or complete designated tasks (such as escorting and puzzle - solving) within the specified time, you will fail the level, which creates a strong sense of urgency.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game contains strong language and extreme violence.

short_description: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.
